caribbean.headline: Heavy Showers and 5.2 ft Seas Near St. Lucia
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing light easterly winds of 10 kt, seas around 5.2 ft with an ENE swell period of 7 s, and 75% rain probability. I expect intermittent heavy showers to reduce visibility in Castries and near Martinique (12 kt winds reported), so I advise mariners to monitor local radar and secure loose deck gear.

mediterranean.headline: Small Craft Advisory Conditions Near Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northwest swell with sustained winds up to 23 kt, a dominant NW swell at a 7 s period and significant wave heights near 6.8 ft, and I expect Small Craft Advisory conditions for local traffic. Haifa is the runner-up with lighter 14 kt winds and relatively calmer seas, and I note less than 10% rain probability across the eastern Mediterranean.
